title_en: Fall 2026 Master's and Doctoral Thesis Review Public Presentation Schedule (Subject to Change)
summary: The schedules for the Fall 2026 master's thesis public presentations and doctoral preliminary review (초심) public presentations are provided in two attached PDF files, which were not read for this translation. The schedules may change at any time, including times and locations. Attendees, including students taking the Master's/Doctoral Seminar (석박사세미나), must check the attached schedule again on the day of the review.
applies_to: All attendees of the Fall 2026 master's and doctoral thesis review public presentations, including students taking the Master's/Doctoral Seminar (석박사세미나). Checking the latest attached schedule on the day of the review is mandatory for attendees.

dates.what: Final check of the attached schedule for any changes to time or location (all attendees, including Master's/Doctoral Seminar students)
dates.when: On the day of the review itself; the actual presentation dates are in the attachments, which were not read

conditions: The schedules in the attachments may change at any time without separate notice.
Times and locations of presentations may change, so attendees must not rely on an earlier copy of the schedule.
The actual dates, times and rooms are only in the attached PDF files, which were not read for this translation.
steps: Download and read the attached schedules on the original notice: "2026-2학기 석사 심사 일정.pdf" (master's review schedule) and "2026-2학기 박사 초심 일정.pdf" (doctoral preliminary review schedule).
Check the attachments again for updates, because the schedule is updated at any time.
On the day of the review, open the latest attached file once more to confirm the time and location before attending.
For questions, contact the department office (Building 301, Room 319); contact details are in the original notice.
translation:
★(Subject to change) Fall 2026 Master's/Doctoral Thesis Review Public Presentation Schedule

We announce the schedule for the Fall 2026 master's/doctoral thesis review public presentations.

1. Master's public presentation schedule
- Please refer to the attached file (the contents may change at any time).

2. Doctoral public presentation (preliminary review, 초심) schedule
- Please refer to the attached file (the contents may change at any time).

3. Notes
- The public presentation schedule (attached file) is updated at any time. Since times, locations, etc. may change, attendees, including students taking the Master's/Doctoral Seminar (석박사세미나), must check the attached file again on the day of the review.

4. Inquiries
- Department Administration Office (Building 301, Room 319). The staff member's name, phone number and email are given in the original notice.

Attachments (2):
- 2026-2학기 박사 초심 일정.pdf (Fall 2026 doctoral preliminary review schedule, 195 KB)
- 2026-2학기 석사 심사 일정.pdf (Fall 2026 master's review schedule, 258 KB)

[Note: The contents of the attached files were not read and are not included in this translation.]
